title: Focus shortcut, guided tour, smoother themes

cards.title: A tour, and this deck
cards.body:
What's new? this tour deck is!
From now on every new feature will be introduced this way for better understanding.

You can replay this changelog tour - along with brand new *Welcome Tour* - whenever you like.

cards.title: Info Tab
cards.body:
We moved around some Setting items into a new tab: *Info* tab.

Here you can view credits, support & feedback sections.
More importantly, you can check and replay Welcome Tour and version changelog tour decks in *Feature Guide* sub-page

cards.title: Bring Shift back with the controller
cards.body:
Pick a shortcut in *Settings > General > Focus shortcut* and Shift comes to the front from anywhere: a running game, the desktop, another app.

Double-tap [VIEW] or [MENU], or hold one of them.

changelog: New: *Focus shortcut*. Pick a controller shortcut in Settings > General that brings Shift to the front from a game, the desktop, or another app. Double-tap or hold [VIEW] or [MENU]; the trigger button is muted so it does not reach whatever was in front.

New: *Welcome Tour* and *Feature Guide*, in the new Settings > App Info tab. The tour walks the real screen and points at things as it explains them; the guide keeps a deck for each of the last few versions.
New: Loading shimmer for the Shelf theme instead of an empty shelf.
Menus got a backdrop blur, the Visuals tab scrolls when it runs out of room, and menu navigation was reweighted.
A logo now waits until its image is ready rather than popping in, and focus follows you when you switch theme.
Swiping the grid works again, and is limited to the themes that scroll sideways.
The launch popup's hints are clickable, and the cursor hides only once the controller is actually used.
The whole Library tab scrolls now, not just the tag list, so the Tag Manager stays usable on a short screen.
A game that is still installing no longer counts as recently played, and a single press is no longer read as two.
Steam release dates: warming no longer stalls partway through, and a cache that fails to save says so instead of failing silently.
Several tabs no longer stay stuck on a sub-page when the menu is closed from outside.
Several other performance improvements, bug fixes, and UI polish.
